dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: If I were you, I'd pick a spot against the wall to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: That little corner over there looks pretty safe.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Still, such places usually don't have very good air circulation. If that's a problem for you, maybe I can fan you with my wings?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: You're not hurt, are you? Me neither. I'm actually holding up a lot better than I expected in these fights...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: So there's no need to worry about my safety. What's important is that you don't go putting yourself in danger on my account!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Please, trust me to protect myself and to protect you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I'd like to see if any of Mother's books are here.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Even though I've already read every single one cover to cover...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Every time I pass by a bookshelf, I always look for any traces she may have left behind...
